goals: Make Inventory Particles agree with representative Matcha component-backed items and Ribbits item visuals without changing either upstream project.
scope: C3 is a resource-pack-only Inventory Particles overlay: it guards all four upstream poisonous-potato holders for three exact Matcha item-model components, adds component-specific replacements, isolates public Ribbits particle textures, and narrowly excludes only the automatic fallback paths that would otherwise accumulate on the three exact Ribbits targets.

exclusions: Inventory Particles, Matcha Flavoured, Ribbits, trinkets-inventory-extended-compat, unrelated automatic family behavior, and protected/private artwork remain independently owned and unmodified.

dependencies.reason: C3 targets the audited client resource loader, its serialized-stack predicate format, its separate literal/family fallback resource loaders, and its exact NbtNode codec.
Provides the three exact public item identities rendered as C1 particle textures.
Authoritative source for the three Matcha poisonous-potato component identities.
Immutable exact artifact audited and deterministically used only to preserve its two overridden JSON resources.

state.milestone: C1 remains the user-reported external partial RUNTIME_FAIL: Green Curry leaked poisonous-potato particles, Glowcap had no visible particle, and the Ribbit Village Explorer Map showed gray/sand-like particles; Ramen and Crystal Heart were not tested, and no result was supplied for Toadstool Heart. C2 is retained as RUNTIME_FAIL / RESOURCE_RELOAD_FAIL: Inventory Particles rejected its two this_type:number predicates, then failed to find the fallback family and Minecraft removed the selected resource packs. C3 is the current corrected canary, ACTIVE / STATIC_PASS / NOT_DEPLOYED / RUNTIME_UNTESTED; it occupies no test slot.
